pilot.boundary: Fixed six-task functional pilot repeated with unchanged models, uniform settings, host rule, quality oracles and cost thresholds. No general quality/cost/latency claim. All failures, calls and repairs count.

resolvedValidationIncidents.result: 14 failures and two passing controls established missing paths before fixes.

resolvedValidationIncidents.issue: Old factory mocks omitted a newly imported internal helper
resolvedValidationIncidents.resolution: Partial mocks now retain actual module exports; no required provider member added.

resolvedValidationIncidents.issue: Temporary session journals raced recursive cleanup under parallel unit load
resolvedValidationIncidents.resolution: Bounded filesystem cleanup retries; final full suite passes.

resolvedValidationIncidents.issue: Google suspended test replaced semantic content with bare invalid text; formatter preserved that replacement
resolvedValidationIncidents.resolution: Corrupt JSON syntax while preserving actual candidate semantics. Targeted Google rerun and final full matrix pass.

googleStreamingDiagnostic.originalCause: Unproven: the original suffix miss did not recur in 52 instrumented controls; raw SDK text equaled Agent output in every control. No converter loss was observed.
googleStreamingDiagnostic.resolution: Preserve exact evidence oracles; use temperature zero and direct streaming hook edits for intended 512-token output cap, retain status/stop-reason diagnostics. Final whole-suite rerun passes.

liveGateIncident.issue: One earlier Google streaming retrieval fixture omitted _STREAM from the second marker in the initial full matrix.
liveGateIncident.resolution: Preserve exact marker oracles; stabilize fixture sampling at zero, apply intended output cap with supported in-place streaming hook edits, retain status/stop-reason diagnostics; entire affected suite rerun passes. No production source change or hidden test retry.
